```cpp
const Profile::MESG* Profile::GetMesg(const FIT_UINT16 num)
{

    static FIT_UINT16 keys[HASH_SIZE];
    static FIT_UINT16 vals[HASH_SIZE];
    static bool initialized = false;

    {

            keys[i] = 0xFFFF;
            vals[i] = 0xFFFF;

                slot = (slot + 1) & HASH_MASK;
            }
            if (vals[slot] == 0xFFFF)

                keys[slot] = n;
                vals[slot] = static_cast<FIT_UINT16>(i);

        initialized = true;

    FIT_UINT32 slot = (static_cast<FIT_UINT32>(num) * 2654435761u) >> 22;

        if (v == 0xFFFF)
            return NULL;
        if (keys[slot] == num)
            return &mesgs[v];
        slot = (slot + 1) & HASH_MASK;
    }
}
```

```cpp
        if (e == 0xFFFFFFFFu)

        if ((e >> 16) == num)

}
```
